bug_semantics: Xinference model loaders invoke Hugging Face AutoTokenizer/from_pretrained (and sentence-transformers/FlagEmbedding equivalents) with trust_remote_code hardcoded or defaulted to True, so a model directory can execute its own modeling_*.py via tokenizer_config.json/config.json auto_map. The confirmed attack is: a caller with model-launch access POSTs a rerank registration with type=unknown and an attacker-controlled model_path; RerankModel.__init__ calls _auto_detect_type -> _get_tokenizer -> AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model_path, trust_remote_code=True), which imports and runs attacker Python as the worker. Five sibling sites (SentenceTransformer rerank/embedding load, FlagEmbedding load, PytorchModel._sanitize_model_config setdefault True, and PytorchModel._get_components default True) independently enable the same remote-code flag. Before 2.12.0 there was no operator opt-out; 2.12.0 gates generic loaders with XINFERENCE_TRUST_REMOTE_CODE (default off) and allow_trust_remote_code(model_family) so only bundled is_builtin families keep remote code.
flaw_origin: The exploited auto-detect sink was first written in reconstructable PR #1538 member 224f81247ca5cf5ac6ede9009e1d3e690153e98e (codingl2k1, 2024-05-23): it changed RerankModelSpec.type default from normal to unknown and added _auto_detect_type that calls AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model_path, trust_remote_code=True). Immediate parent 7c6465cbffcf238d03d587791f4adad10996f849 has neither the unknown default nor any tokenizer load in xinference/model/rerank/core.py. GitHub squash-landing d4c4fa91c0da662c731cc620b0ead75d8686f0a4 is an aggregate of 224f812 plus follow-up 58ab640247675d9cae8e94e11172760ff439df9d (test-only gated-repo try/except) and is not the BIC. 5cef7c3d4bb0c5208d262fc3ffb7d7083724de1c later extracted the same True literal into RerankModel._get_tokenizer (move/refactor, not a first-write). Sibling loader sites were added in other commits and are extra sinks of the same class, not the first write of this attack path.

reasoning: CVE-2026-76841 is a real CWE-94 RCE: Hugging Face remote code is unconditionally enabled in six generic loaders, and the reporter's end-to-end path is rerank auto-detect on type=unknown. CVE.org is PUBLISHED (not rejected/withdrawn); GHSA is not withdrawn; #5023's stale-bot close is not a vendor false-positive. The smallest first-write of the exploited lines is PR #1538 member 224f812, which introduced both the unknown default and AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(..., trust_remote_code=True) in _auto_detect_type. That content is absent on immediate parent 7c6465cb. The mainline object d4c4fa91 is a squash aggregate and was decomposed; 58ab640 is test-only; 5cef7c3d only extracted _get_tokenizer. LLM transformers' earlier setdefault True (#500 / 3a5082f) is a related pattern and one of the six later-gated sites, but it is not the first write of the auto-detect tokenizer sink the advisory's PoC uses. 224f812 is a human-authored/committed object with no commit-object AI marker, so the verdict is NOT_AI. The public fix is #5027 landing 77511b4, first tagged in v2.12.0.
